caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden table with a drop-leaf design, shown in perspective to display both the top and one side. The table is rendered in shades of brown, giving a realistic wood grain appearance. The tabletop is rectangular, with one side folded down, exposing a hinge and a support bracket underneath. The table is supported by a central, turned pedestal that extends downward to four curved legs. Each leg ends in a brass-colored claw foot that rests on small wheels or casters. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or decorative elements included in the composition. There is a small, neatly handwritten signature and date in the lower right corner reading "Lilah Brown 92."
title: Table, Drop-leaf
